test_cases.name: Normal Movement Without Interference
test_cases.setup: Detector in IDLE state; plan Bezier curve (300,300) -> (1200,700).
test_cases.action: Execute autonomous movement without user physical input.
test_cases.expected_result: Action completes fully without triggering false takeover; returns to IDLE.
test_cases.limitations: Verified under zero physical input interference.

test_cases.name: Significant Trajectory Departure
test_cases.action: Inject user physical movement event with 400px deviation away from Bezier curve.
test_cases.expected_result: Detector detects anomaly; transitions to PAUSED_BY_USER; cancels injection.
test_cases.actual_observation: Detector transitioned to PAUSED_BY_USER. Autonomous injection cancelled.
test_cases.limitations: Simulated physical event triggers immediate pause.

test_cases.name: Small Movement During PRECISE_CLICK
test_cases.setup: ORBIT performing PRECISE_CLICK with tight adaptive threshold (~16px).
test_cases.action: Inject small 25px physical deviation during click approach.
test_cases.expected_result: Tight envelope flags deviation; state transitions safely to PAUSED_BY_USER.
test_cases.actual_observation: State transitioned to PAUSED_BY_USER. Threshold caught 25px deviation.
test_cases.limitations: Adaptive envelope correctly scales down for precision actions.

test_cases.name: Physical Mouse Click During Movement
test_cases.action: Receive physical LBUTTON_DOWN event from user.
test_cases.expected_result: Immediate pause on button press regardless of cursor position.
test_cases.actual_observation: State transitioned to PAUSED_BY_USER. Input cancelled.
test_cases.limitations: Physical clicks always trigger immediate takeover.

test_cases.name: Physical Keyboard Keypress During Execution
test_cases.expected_result: Autonomous execution pauses instantly; user gains ownership.
test_cases.limitations: Physical keystrokes reliably pause active agent actions.

test_cases.name: Drag Operation Interruption & Release Sanitation
test_cases.setup: ORBIT performing DRAG_OPERATION with left mouse button held down.
test_cases.action: User introduces orthogonal physical deviation during drag.
test_cases.expected_result: Autonomous drag stops; state transitions to PAUSED_BY_USER; no stuck mouse buttons.
test_cases.actual_observation: State transitioned to PAUSED_BY_USER. Input cancelled cleanly.
test_cases.limitations: Prevents stuck mouse buttons upon drag interruption.

test_cases.name: User Takeover During Text Input
test_cases.setup: ORBIT actively typing text into a control.
test_cases.action: User moves mouse or presses physical key.
test_cases.limitations: Text input category detects zero-tolerance mouse touches.

test_cases.name: User Inactivity Transition to RELEASE_PENDING
test_cases.setup: System in PAUSED_BY_USER state following takeover.
test_cases.action: Observe system after 1000ms of complete user inactivity.
test_cases.expected_result: Transitions to RELEASE_PENDING; NEVER automatically resumes autonomous execution.
test_cases.actual_observation: State transitioned to RELEASE_PENDING. System holds in non-executing state awaiting re-observation.
test_cases.limitations: Inactivity signals release readiness without risking blind autonomous action replay.

test_cases.name: Rapid Alternating Movement Stability
test_cases.setup: ORBIT initiating movement while user introduces high-frequency rapid jitter.
test_cases.action: Receive 5 rapid alternating physical movement events in 50ms.
test_cases.expected_result: State locks immediately to PAUSED_BY_USER; zero cursor fighting or oscillation.
test_cases.actual_observation: State securely locked to PAUSED_BY_USER. Injection halted on first anomaly.
test_cases.limitations: Safety latch guarantees stable one-way transition to pause.

test_cases.name: Ambiguous Injected-Input Classification
test_cases.action: Receive synthetic injected event lacking valid ORBIT extraInfo signature.
test_cases.expected_result: Ambiguity treated conservatively as potential user takeover; transitions to PAUSED_BY_USER.
test_cases.actual_observation: Ambiguity handled via safety invariant -> Transitioned to PAUSED_BY_USER.
test_cases.limitations: Non-negotiable safety invariant: Ambiguous input always pauses autonomous execution.
